title: Introduction Body Hover Emphasizes Content
description: When the mouse is inside the body of the introduction step window, all content should be emphasized (text and icons), matching existing shell hover emphasis patterns. Keep celebrate paint intact.
summary: Blank-line introduction bodies now render as separate paragraphs so only the hovered paragraph emphasizes. Fixed Aggregator welcome step where one whitespace-pre-line p wrapped two visual paragraphs. Added splitIntroductionBodyParagraphs and vitest coverage.
